open_blocking.title: The PR body puts a Linear closing word directly before OVD-628 ('This PR does not close OVD-628'), which coordinator decision c0997604 forbids
open_blocking.evidence:
In the PR #580 body (get, head fe74bba), the Scope > Not included bullet reads: "its hardening follow-up is OVD-628 (OVD-629 was closed as a duplicate of it). This PR does not close OVD-628;". Linear's magic-word parser matches '<close|closes|closed|closing|fix…|resolve…|complete…> <ID>' and does not understand negation, so 'close OVD-628' reads as a closing reference.

Coordinator comment c0997604 says: "The PR body must not use Linear closing words for them [OVD-628, OVD-629]."

OVD-628 (get_issue) is still open (status Backlog). PR #580 is already attached to it (attachment 98960abc, 'OVD-598: Serialize legacy Xometry admission with fail-fast pre-locked rows'). The OVD-628 description also plans its own PR after #580 and #592. A merge of #580 could therefore move OVD-628 to Done. The other occurrences are safe: 'Plain mentions; this PR does not close either.' has no ID next to the word, and 'OVD-629 was closed as a duplicate' has the ID before the word.
open_blocking.suggested_fix: Reword with no closing verb next to the ID, e.g. "OVD-628 stays open; this PR is not its fix." Then search the body for every closing magic word followed by an OVD- ID (regex `(close|fix|resolve|complete)\w*\s+OVD-\d+`, case-insensitive) and confirm there are no hits.

open_blocking.title: The 'precise' invariant leaves out a post-NOWAIT heavyweight wait: the commercial-rollout:automatic_quote_collection shared advisory lock. The claim is false as written in the header, the PR body, the write-target table and the Linear criteria (no cycle results).
open_blocking.evidence:
The claim, in the migration header :31-35, the PR body Invariant paragraph and the OVD-598 first acceptance criterion: "after the NOWAIT block, the request's only heavyweight waits are the founding-beta shared advisory lock ... and the implicit KEY SHARE on the organization and user FK parents". The table preface says every step is a held row, a fresh insert "or one of the two named allowed waits". Its first row lists only `founding-beta:<org>` for the resolver, `resolve_quote_access` and `resolve_quote_access_for_permit`.

The code takes a third wait:
- The helper runs at 20261004100000:175. The resolver is called at :177 and private.resolve_quote_access at :211.
- Both reach private.resolve_quote_access_for_permit. The resolver calls it at 20261002182910:165, after its founding-beta lock at :149.
- In that function the founding-beta shared lock is at 20261002182910:37-38. Then, for an eligible organization, :68 calls private.automatic_quote_rollout_enabled_with_lock().
- That function (20260802031257:22-38) runs pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('commercial-rollout:automatic_quote_collection',0)).
- Nothing before the NOWAIT block takes this key. lock_free_quote_capacity (20261002182714:134-160) takes only free-quote-config shared and the free-quote-subject keys, so this is a fresh wait after the row locks.

Its exclusive holder is public.api_set_commercial_rollout_control (20260802020349:238; lock at :291-293; executable by service_role only, :400-408). After the lock it takes only private.commercial_rollout_controls FOR UPDATE, which the request reads without a lock, and inserts events. So it closes no cycle, but the invariant's list of allowed waits is incomplete.
open_blocking.suggested_fix: Add the commercial-rollout:automatic_quote_collection shared advisory lock to the invariant in the PR body and the OVD-598 first criterion, and as an allowed wait in the write-target table's first row. Name its holder condition: the sole exclusive holder is the service_role-only api_set_commercial_rollout_control, which then locks only the rollout-control row and inserts events. For the migration header, either correct it (this re-pins the 5b6801f8 hash and needs a fresh hosted run, plus the #592 pin) or disclose the omission in the body, as the body already does for the shorthand parenthetical.

nonblocking.title: The invariant's parenthetical 'every holder of that lock takes its row locks before it' is wrong for the generic request
nonblocking.evidence: Migration header :31-33 and the OVD-598 first criterion say "(every holder of that lock takes its row locks before it and never waits afterwards on a row this request holds)". However, api_request_provider_dispatch takes founding-beta shared in its resolver (20261003160000:454-456) and only afterwards calls private.request_scoped_automatic_quote_impl, which upserts the line item and updates jobs. Those row locks come after the advisory lock. Header :35-37 then states the precise condition ('no holder, after taking it, waits on a lock that conflicts with one this request holds'), and that condition holds: those rows belong to the generic request's own job, which is serialized by quote-lane-submit. The parenthetical is the verbatim wording from 317c7134, and the PR body discloses the header shorthand.
nonblocking.suggested_fix: Optional: at the next migration-hash re-pin, drop the parenthetical, or put the precise holder condition in the Linear criterion as well.
